items.title: Road to DevFest Ibadan 2026: Web Track Kickoff
items.text:
Date: 7 November 2026, 08:00 UTC
Ends: 7 November 2026, 13:00 UTC
Location: Practicode Academy, 7B Oba Olagbegi, Old Bodija, Ibadan, Nigeria.
Registration: Free registration

Join us for an exciting edition of our "Road to DevFest 2026" series, focusing on the Web Track, now scheduled for November 7, 2026, at Practicode Academy, instead of the previously announced October 24 date! 🚀

Whether you're an experienced developer or a curious beginner, this event is your opportunity to dive into the world of web development through hands-on workshops and insightful talks. Engage with industry experts, connect with fellow developers, and explore how to build innovative web solutions that can transform lives.

Don't miss this opportunity to elevate your web development skills, learn from the community, and be part of the journey towards DevFest Ibadan 2026.

Mark your calendars for November 7 and join us as we build towards the future of technology! 🎉

items.title: DevFest Ibadan 2026
items.text:
Date: 21 November 2026, 06:00 UTC
Ends: 21 November 2026, 17:03 UTC
Location: Kakanfo Inn & Conference Center, Mobile, Ibadan
Registration: External registration

DevFest Ibadan is the largest Google Developer Group event happening in the City of Ibadan, where we host thousands of developers on a 1-day activity-packed event focused on technical learning, shared passion for Google products, and networking with like-minded minds. GDG Ibadan is brewing something different this year.

We'll be having the DevFest Ibadan 2026 event and a Pre-DevFest Ibadan 2026 series spanning 4 weeks as a buildup to DevFest Ibadan 2026 at selected hubs across Ibadan and Oyo State in general. Where we'll be having expert-led hands-on workshops that cut across all sectors.

Now in its 7th edition, DevFest Ibadan has grown in scale and impact over the years, attracting thousands of attendees from across Oyo State and beyond.

Join us for the annual developer festival in the city of Ibadan. This event promises to be bigger, better, and grander, featuring talks and sessions ranging from technical discussions to mental health talks, as well as what has changed in us as techies. Most importantly, the event provides another avenue to network with people.

This event will take place on Saturday, November 21, 2026.

DevFest is an annual decentralized tech conference hosted by Google Developer Groups across the globe. The theme this year is "Building Safe, Secure, and Scalable Solutions with AI and Cloud."

Everything you've come to love about DevFest Ibadan is coming back this year, bigger and better. 🔥

Here's what's in store for you:

Cutting-Edge Tech Talks.

Engaging panel sessions with industry experts.

Hands-on workshops where you can dive deep into the latest tech trends.

Networking.
